# Slice 5b: P9/P10 (docs/proofs/analysis.md:344-351, :406-410), docs/api-5.md section 2. Expected lines written
# by hand before the driver code. gamma at p=2, alpha=1, s=2: (1-1/4)/(1-2) = -3/4. Ramified p=5, alpha=1,
# digits 5 prints the rounding error of the midpoint: 3e-5 and 1.4e-5. Real e=0, s=1/2: Gamma(1/4) rgamma(1/4) = 1.
# Real zero s=-2: exact 0. Real pole s=1 (e=0): DOMAIN. A ball around the pole s=1 at p=3, alpha=1: NOT_DETERMINED.
# epsilon at gamma's poles: 1 at the real place (e=0, s=1) and at p=3 (alpha=1, s=1); i for e=1 at s=2.
# The radii 3e-39 and 1.1e-38 of the exact decimals -0.75 and 1 depend on internal rounding: guessed as 1e-38
# before the run and corrected from it (lanes/t5-slice3/redgreen.md); both are below 2^-120.
prec 128
digits 5
tate_gamma ((2) + (0)*i ; 0) with 2 with ((1) + (0)*i ; 0) with char(q=1, n=1, s=(0) + (0)*i)
tate_gamma ((0) + (0)*i ; 0) with 5 with ((1) + (0)*i ; 0) with char(q=5, n=2, s=(0) + (0)*i)
tate_gamma ((0.5) + (0)*i ; 0) with real with ((1) + (0)*i ; 0) with char(q=1, n=1, s=(0) + (0)*i)
tate_gamma ((-2) + (0)*i ; 0) with real with ((1) + (0)*i ; 0) with char(q=1, n=1, s=(0) + (0)*i)
tate_gamma ((1) + (0)*i ; 0) with real with ((1) + (0)*i ; 0) with char(q=1, n=1, s=(0) + (0)*i)
tate_epsilon ((1) + (0)*i ; 0) with real with ((1) + (0)*i ; 0) with char(q=1, n=1, s=(0) + (0)*i)
tate_epsilon ((1) + (0)*i ; 0) with 3 with ((1) + (0)*i ; 0) with char(q=1, n=1, s=(0) + (0)*i)
tate_epsilon ((2) + (0)*i ; 0) with real with ((1) + (0)*i ; 0) with char(q=4, n=3, s=(0) + (0)*i)
tate_epsilon ((0) + (0)*i ; 0) with 5 with ((1) + (0)*i ; 0) with char(q=5, n=2, s=(0) + (0)*i)
